$schema_notes: Source of truth for the Official-First maintenance model (Phase 3B-38). Read by scripts/release/official-first-plan.ts. Do not hand-edit patch entries without also updating the commit series on official-first/<version> and re-running the drift checker (official-first-plan.ts --drift).

patches.subject: fix(authz): revalidate delegated owner authority at execution
patches.notes: Live re-authorization of a delegated subagent's owning OAuth client at tool-execution time. Upstream has no equivalent — a revoked/rescoped owner would otherwise still be trusted for the lifetime of an in-flight job.

patches.subject: fix(authz): enforce null-binding-folds-to-empty + delegating-scope coverage
patches.notes: Registration-time submit_agent validation: null bound_slug_prefixes must fold to empty (deny), and a delegating client's own scope must cover what it delegates. Confirmed upstream v0.47.4 still has the underlying 016-class gap (null bypasses validation).

patches.subject: feat(mcp): restore /mcp-v2 alias + AUTHZ-INV-013 admin/OAuth/webhook audit trail
patches.notes: Bundled by design: /mcp-v2 backs a live, configured external Connector (compatibility); AUTHZ-INV-013 adds admin/OAuth/webhook audit logging (security). Highest-risk file in the whole stack — most actively developed by upstream, and the one place a real regression occurred (see mcp-v2-metrics-fix).

patches.subject: chore(ops): bring over governed release pipeline + local git governance
patches.notes: None of these files exist in pure official — purely additive, zero shared lines with official's own files, so conflict probability on future rebases is ~zero regardless of upstream churn.

patches.subject: fix(minions): use ps -o etime= instead of lstart= (test-tooling only)
patches.notes: Non-security, test-determinism-only (avoids a timezone-sensitive PID-reuse guard flake under bun test's UTC pinning). Explicitly classified as a LOW-COST TOOLING PATCH — the one item in the stack that could be revisited/dropped in a future review without materially changing security or runtime behavior.

patches.subject: feat(ops): add DCR-disabled deployment invariant to preflight gate
patches.notes: Replaces the old DCR_ALLOWED_SCOPES SOURCE patch (intentionally dropped — see dropped_from_old_fork) with a deployment-time policy gate: fails closed if --enable-dcr appears in the launchd ProgramArguments. Reads ONLY :ProgramArguments, never :EnvironmentVariables — cannot expose the bootstrap token.

patches.subject: test(authz): fix official fixture gap + drop stale DCR assertion (Phase 16)
patches.notes: Required companion to authz-016-017/authz-005-006 — without it, official's own pre-existing test fixtures fail closed against the new AUTHZ-INV-017 scope-coverage check for reasons unrelated to the patch's correctness (mock ctx.auth never populated scopes).

patches.subject: test(ops): add DCR-disabled deployment invariant test (Phase 17)
patches.notes: Proves dcr-deployment-invariant fails closed (incl. no bypass by ProgramArguments reordering, zero token exposure, byte-identical plist before/after).

patches.subject: fix(serve-http): restore official's #3893 /metrics wiring dropped by the mcp-v2/AUTHZ-INV-013 patch
patches.notes: Corrective patch: reconstructing mcp-v2-authz-013 via a historical fork-wide diff (forbidden going forward — see docs/OFFICIAL-FIRST-UPGRADE.md) silently reverted official's own #3893 (Prometheus /metrics endpoint) because the fork's historical baseline predated it. Caught by the one-time full-suite gate, not by inspection. cli-flag-registry.generated.ts is a regenerated build artifact (scripts/generate-flag-registry.ts), not hand-authored.

patches.subject: fix(deploy): wait for confirmed process exit before backup, not just port-free
patches.notes: Fixes the TOCTOU race that caused a real Phase 3B-35 production deploy failure (backup raced a still-shutting-down process). Proven closed in production during Phase 3B-37.

patches.subject: test(security): pin get_status_snapshot's admin-scope gate + unscoped-source residual
patches.notes: v0.47.6 refresh audit finding: #4592 (get_stats/get_health/get_brain_identity source-grant confinement) never touched get_status_snapshot, a different file (src/core/ops/skills-catalog.ts) whose handler still runs an unscoped sources query. Pins that a read-only remote OAuth grant is denied at the serve-http admin-scope dispatch gate before reaching the handler, and documents (does not fix) the residual unscoped disclosure for any caller who does hold admin scope.

high_risk_files.reason: Carries mcp-v2-authz-013 (highest risk in the stack) — most actively developed file by upstream; the one place a real regression (dropped /metrics) already occurred once via the now-forbidden reconstruction method.
Carries authz-016-017 (submit_agent registration-time delegation validation) — moderate upstream churn expected.
Carries authz-005-006 (execution-time owner-authority reauth) — the core delegated-tool trust boundary.
Shared types for authz-005-006 — a narrow, low-churn file, but a signature change here ripples into brain-allowlist.ts/subagent.ts.
Shared audit-log writer used by both authz-005-006 and mcp-v2-authz-013.

dropped_from_old_fork.reason: Confirmed default-off/unused in production config (~/.gbrain/config.json has no reference). Safe to drop. If it ever reappears in a future official-first diff without an explicit manifest entry, the drift checker must flag it (Phase 8).

forbidden_reconciliation_methods: historical fork/master merge into a new official base
any reconstruction method that diffs against a fork snapshot older than the CURRENT official_base
approved_reconciliation_method: pure official base (official-tracking/<version>) + cherry-pick/rebase-replay of the patches[] commits in the listed order, resolving conflicts only in the flagged high_risk_files
